request.task: Harden scripts/jev_qc.mjs after the PR #30 security review: require JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_URL from the environment (no committed default), send an optional X-Jev-QC-Token header from JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_TOKEN, and write only the webhook host to evidence records.
completion_requirements: The script no longer contains a hard-coded webhook URL
With JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_URL unset the script fails closed with exit 3 and makes no request
With JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_URL and JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_TOKEN set, the request reaches the live gate and a decision is returned
Evidence records contain the webhook host but not the full webhook URL or the token

evidence.implementation: scripts/jev_qc.mjs blob 6abb854e74b6609b896c72969daf746694364221 on branch claude/affectionate-dijkstra-8p64qa (PR ebyron357/Clientverse-crm#30). DEFAULT_WEBHOOK_URL constant removed; webhookUrl = process.env.JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_URL (no fallback); header X-Jev-QC-Token added only when JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_TOKEN is set; record field webhook_url replaced by webhook_host and auth_header_sent.
evidence.tests: node --check scripts/jev_qc.mjs -> exit 0. grep -c -E 'https?://|n8n\.cloud|/webhook/' scripts/jev_qc.mjs -> 0 (no URL literal remains; line 36 reads const webhookUrl = (process.env.JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_URL || '').trim(), with no fallback). Run with JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_URL unset -> exit 3, banner 'QC GATE ERROR — FAIL CLOSED', gate_error 'JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_URL is not set', n8n_execution_id null, gate_response null (submit() is never called on this branch). Run with JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_URL='not a url' -> exit 3, gate_error 'JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_URL is not a valid URL'.
evidence.build: No build step: zero-dependency Node ESM script.
evidence.deployment: Not applicable: a client script; the n8n workflow was not modified.
evidence.verification: Live run already completed with JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_URL and JEV_QC_WEBHOOK_TOKEN both set: the gate answered HTTP 200 with qc_engine 'TypeSafe Jev', a server-side submitted_at of 2026-09-28T17:52:22.892Z, the submitted task_id echoed back, and n8n_execution_id 147 (the previous execution was 146), i.e. the request reached n8n and a decision was returned. The resulting record's keys are exactly auth_header_sent, gate_error, gate_response, n8n_execution_id, request, submitted_at, verdict, verified_complete, webhook_host; webhook_host = 'bwa357.app.n8n.cloud', auth_header_sent = true, there is no webhook_url key. A string search of both the written record file and the script's stdout found neither the webhook path segment 'jev-qc-central-gate' nor the token value (both False).
